thinking_format_note: At thinking-disabled inference the template prompt already ends with "<think></think>", while direct-answer training targets also START with "<think></think>" and supervise it; the model may therefore be trained to emit a second empty think block / stray "</think>". Candidate cause of the </think> leakage seen in CROSSLINGUAL-DIAGNOSIS; masking those tokens is an opt-in recipe change (--mask-empty-think), not enabled by default.
